scope: controlled-response integrity, exact sentiment identity coverage, invalid and non-finite score rejection, bounded NLP configuration, source-grounded skill extraction, source-review presence-count semantics, generated-theme prevalence suppression, topic sampling disclosure, component-level partial status, legacy process_all compatibility, cache schema validation, and dataset-provenance fencing
confirmed_findings_fixed: The full NLP pipeline logged completion but returned None; process_all now returns its governed result for both the API and legacy Streamlit consumer.
Sentiment batches could return a subset of requested employee identities; every accepted batch now requires exact one-to-one identity coverage, and failed batches remain missing rather than neutral.
Sentiment output now rejects booleans, non-finite values, out-of-range scores and score/label contradictions before aggregation.
NLP configuration values for batch size, review length and topic count now require bounded integer contracts before model calls can run.
Duplicate or invalid review identities no longer reach row-level model inference.
Skill output now enforces the declared 15-item category limit and rejects skills without a literal case-insensitive source-text mention.
Skill counts are explicitly labeled as the number of source reviews containing a skill, not token-frequency counts or validated prevalence.
Topic prompts no longer request prevalence; returned model prevalence is discarded, duplicate theme names fail closed, and the first-50 sampling scope is disclosed.
Same-snapshot cached NLP responses now undergo schema validation; malformed cached evidence is cleared and rejected with HTTP 409 instead of being reused or becoming an unhandled server error.

Fresh NLP result construction and unexpected pipeline failures now fail closed with no cache commit; component status and unprocessed sentiment observations remain observable when analysis is partial.
confirmed_behavior_not_claimed: Controlled fixtures establish response and provenance integrity only; they do not establish LLM accuracy.
No labeled review corpus or held-out corpus was available for this cycle, so extraction precision, recall and sentiment accuracy are unvalidated.
Negation, irony, multilingual behavior, inter-rater agreement and subgroup stability remain unvalidated.
First-50 theme sampling cannot support workforce-wide prevalence claims, and no prevalence is exposed.
Literal skill grounding improves source traceability but does not establish semantic recall, ontology completeness or skill-extraction validity.
No live Ollama inference was used as a correctness oracle in this cycle.

cross_product_validation.full_repository_validation: 1185_passed_5_failed_6_subtests_passed; failures are the intentionally stale shared audit inventory/hash gate, one unrelated ML performance timeout, and two existing SentimentEngine exact-dictionary assertions

interpretation_boundary: NLPEngine produces exploratory generated sentiment, skills and themes from performance-review text. It is not a validated measurement instrument, prevalence estimator, employee assessment, predictive signal, causal explanation or employment-decision authority.
remaining_scientific_limits: A labeled, organization-relevant and held-out review corpus is required for sentiment accuracy and skill/topic precision-recall evaluation.
Negation, irony, multilingual and code-switched text require stratified test cases and human adjudication.
Human agreement, reviewer guidance, disagreement handling and subgroup error analysis remain required.
Prevalence requires full-population topic assignment with defined missingness and confidence semantics; generated first-50 themes cannot supply it.
Model, prompt, tokenizer and language revisions require repeat validation; local transport availability is not model validity.
Employee-level generated summaries remain retired and no automated HR action is within scope.
release_gate: Local NLP integrity and compatibility contracts are clean. The engine remains exploratory and unavailable for public launch claims until corpus-based accuracy, extraction precision/recall, multilingual/negation/irony behavior, human agreement, and independent owner review are complete.
